title: Multiplayer space where you can submit AI-generated widgets.
author: bemmu
selftext:
I'm actually a programmer by profession since some decades, but this year I feel like.. well, programming by hand may be over, the same way writing assembler by hand was just over except for some special cases when compilers came around. So I've been trying to just embrace the new tools instead, pushing them to see what's possible now.

I made this because I wanted to see how hard it would be to put something on a website with actual login buttons, multiplayer, chat etc. features and it was shockingly doable. It's crazy how long this would have taken manually, possibly months.

Created in two days with Opus 5.5.
